decisions.reason: The firm has sunk development and presentation effort into this two-component injection unit, which sits at the center of its announced plural-component direction, and soft results can still be blamed on pandemic-era construction disruptions.
As a sibling to Product A in the injection range, B supports the firm's tailored-solutions promise, so management would justify keeping it rather than admit the earlier launch was a mistake.
The manual airless gun is a core accessory that pulls through pump and spare-part sales and has been publicly committed for years, so dropping it is unlikely.
This multi-model air-assisted airless line is a large, visible investment in the firm's core spray technology, and management would persist with it.
The data logger embodies the firm's announced move toward innovative digital application technology, so management would treat modest uptake as an early-adoption issue and stick with it.
